title: Sustainability | Winkelmann Group
content: For this reason, our aim is to conserve resources as much as possible during the production process. But sustainability is more than that: For us, sustainability is the combination of economic performance with ecological responsibility and social justice. Therefore, one of our strategic goals is to secure our global manufacturing sites in the long term by ensuring competitiveness and sustainable growth are forward-looking. We are also committed to a sustainable energy supply. At our headquarters in Ahlen, we have completed a unique energy project – a milestone in our company's history. That means that our corporate headquarters and, above all, our automotive plant, *Winkelmann Powertrain Components*, are self-sufficient in terms of power. For a manufacturing company of our size, the fact that we are completely disconnected from the public electricity grid is unique in Germany. At the heart of our microgrid are six combined heat and power plants that generate electricity from natural gas – with the option to use biogas in the future.

title: Winkelmann Group - LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. We are closely connected with our well-known customers from various industrial sectors. Our production sites in Germany, Poland, Turkey, China, Mexico and the USA and 31 sales locations worldwide currently employ more than 4,400 people, which are the basis and guarantee of the company's success. As a grown family business with a turnover of approx. 625 million euros, we think and act on a long-term basis and at the same time innovatively and flexibly. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Our product focus is on engine components for belt drives, drive trains and injection systems. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Our qualified employees guarantee our customers from industry, plant construction, engineering offices, specialist wholesalers and specialist trades personal advice and tailor-made products. Components The Components business unit develops and produces ready-to-install components and assemblies for automotive engineering, aerospace and defence technology. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. For more information, please visit www.winkelmann-group.com/de/karriere/

title: Historie: von 1898 bis heute | Winkelmann Group
content: # Our history: The story of the Winkelmann Group from 1898 to the present day. The company’s story begins in 1898 when Heinrich Winkelmann and Caspar Pannhoff established *Winkelmann + Pannhoff GmbH*. Originally a manufacturer of raw materials for the enamel industry, we quickly grew to become a modern medium-sized company. Today, we are a leading global group of companies for industrial solutions of high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems energy-efficient components and systems. In 1898, Heinrich Winkelmann and Caspar Pannhoff founded the handicraft company Winkelmann + Pannhoff GmbH in Ahlen. In this year Reflex Winkelmann + Pannhoff GmbH is founded in Ahlen, today under the shortened name Reflex Winkelmann GmbH a leading international company in the field of water leading systems in building and supply technology.

title: Company
content: As part of the Winkelmann Building+Industry business unit of the Winkelmann Group in Germany, the brand Winkelmann represents our OEM business with components and systems in buildings of all types and sizes as well as in a wide variety of industrial sectors and industries. **The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading group of companies in metal forming technology for well-known customers from a wide range of industry sectors and encompasses three business divisions: Automotive, Building+Industry and Flowforming.**. As a company anchored in tradition and managed by the fourth generation of the family, long-term thinking and working the principle of success with a high level of flexibility and innovative strength are key values for Winkelmann. The powerful Reflex brand, together with the brands Sinus, Nema and Winkelmann OEM, form the business unit Winkelmann Building+Industry, with an international team of over 2,100 employees and presence in more than 25 countries around the world.
